name: horizonx
description: Search HorizonX and add its animated components, mockups, textures, shaders, templates, UI kits, 3D models and icon libraries to your project.

interface.longDescription: Search the HorizonX catalogue in plain language and drop the result straight into your code: animated UI components, device mockups, image textures and WebGL shaders exported as HTML, Svelte or React, plus landing pages, UI kits, design systems, 3D models and open-source icon libraries as files. Sign in with your HorizonX account.
defaultPrompt: Use HorizonX to add an animated hero background to this page.
Use HorizonX to find a before-and-after image slider and add it as a React component.
Use HorizonX to find a SaaS landing page template.

positive.description: Finds animated hero backgrounds in the component catalogue.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to find an animated background for a dark SaaS hero section.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of matching HorizonX components with names, a one-line description and a link to each.

positive.description: Shows the parameters of one component before exporting it.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to show me the settings I can change on the first result.
positive.expected_behavior: Describes the chosen component and lists its adjustable parameters (colors, speed, sizes) with their default values.

positive.description: Exports a component as React code with custom parameters.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to export that background as a React component with a blue accent color.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a single React component file with no runtime dependencies and the accent color applied. The first export of a component uses one of the member's daily exports.

positive.description: Searches the Library for page templates and kits.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to find a landing page template for a fintech app.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching Library products (templates, UI kits or design systems) with titles, a short description and what files each includes.

positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to get the files for the first template you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the product's details, then returns download links for its files that expire in about five minutes. The first download of a product that day uses one download from the member's plan.

positive.description: Reads a design system's DESIGN.md to build UI in its style.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to find a design system for a fintech dashboard and give me its DESIGN.md.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a matching design system and returns its DESIGN.md: color, typography, spacing and component tokens with the rules for applying them. It does not use a download.

positive.description: Shows the user's screenshot on a phone mockup.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to put this app screenshot on a phone mockup and add it to the page as a Svelte component.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds a phone mockup, passes the screenshot through its images parameter and returns a Svelte embed. The first export of a mockup uses one of the member's daily exports.

positive.description: Finds 3D models in the Library's Assets sections.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to find a 3D model of a chair.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching 3D models (glTF) from the Library with titles and a short description, without downloading anything.

positive.description: Explains the licence of an open-source icon library before downloading it.
positive.prompt: Use HorizonX to find an open-source icon set and tell me its licence.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds an icon library in the Icons section and names its open-source licence from the product details. It does not use a download.

negative.description: Unrelated general question should not call HorizonX.
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: Request for something HorizonX does not offer (stock photos) should not trigger an export or download.
negative.prompt: Use HorizonX to download a stock photo of a mountain.

negative.description: Request to buy or change a subscription should not be handled by the app; it should point the user to horizonx.so.
negative.prompt: Use HorizonX to upgrade my plan to yearly.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.0: device and product mockups, 3D models and open-source icon libraries. First release: search and export HorizonX components, textures and shaders as HTML, Svelte or React, and browse and download Library templates, UI kits and design systems.
